name: flutter_tilt
one_liner: Flutter package for 3D tilt and parallax hover effects with simulated light, shadow and gyroscope support.
what_it_offers: A Flutter widget package that adds tilt and multi-layer parallax effects with simulated light and shadow. It responds to hover, touch and gyroscope sensor input (via sensors_plus) and has configurable parameters. English and Chinese docs, a live demo, and migration guides between breaking versions are available.
tech_stack: Flutter/Dart (SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0, Flutter >=3.19.0); depends on sensors_plus >=6.1.0 <8.0.0; Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, Linux; WASM-ready
portfolio_fit_reason: Flutter-only, so it can't go into a React, Next.js or no-code portfolio. At most it's a behavior reference for tilt-style project cards.
client_ok_note: MIT-licensed, so commercial use is fine inside a Flutter app. For web portfolio sites it only works as a motion reference.
best_use_for_portfolio: Use the live demo to pick tilt angle, glare and shadow values for hover effects on project cards. Then build the effect with a web library such as react-parallax-tilt or Atropos, or with Motion.
tier_reason: Flutter-only, so it can't be used in React, Next.js or no-code portfolio builds. At most a behavior reference for tilt cards.
score_rationale: A well-maintained, high-quality package, but it is Flutter-only. For a React/Next.js/Vite/Tailwind website it is at most a reference for tilt, light and shadow behavior, not something you can install.
commercial_use_license: MIT (OSI-approved). Commercial use allowed; keep the license notice.
agent_friendly: pub.dev package (flutter pub add flutter_tilt) plus the public pub.dev JSON API. No MCP server, shadcn registry or npm package. Not usable in a React/Next.js project.
maintenance_signal: v4.1.0 published 2026-07-29. Last GitHub push 2026-09-07 (fluttercandies/flutter_tilt): 268 stars, 15 forks, 2 open issues. On pub.dev: 370 likes, 160/160 pub points, 10,899 downloads in 30 days, verified publisher amooos.com.
caveats: Off-target platform: Flutter/Dart only, so it cannot be dropped into a React, Next.js or Vite site. Flutter Web output is a canvas app, a poor fit for SEO-focused marketing sites. Gyroscope features need sensors_plus and device sensor support.
